en: A monochrome blue-toned postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with many people swimming in the waves and sunbathing on the sand. Behind the beach stands a long, modernist-style waterfront bath complex with terraces and railings, set below a tree-covered hill. The scene is lively and summery. Text in Cyrillic and German appears along the bottom margin, identifying the place as the sea baths of Varna.
